Kwame, I've booked the 30-minute Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 Central, with you and Bettina.

I left your night-dispatch contact's name out of the event notes. Bettina is an attendee and will see them, and you'd told me you hadn't shared that name with the team yet. If you want it on the event, reply to me in our DM and I'll add it, or you can edit the notes yourself.
